fichas.title: Fluorescent Tube Light-Colour Recommendations
fichas.summary: A reference table recommends fluorescent-tube light colours for application areas. It groups lamp codes under warm white, neutral white and daylight white, and distinguishes a recommendation from a possible application. The table also lists colour-rendering values for the lamp codes.
